facts.fact: 本章开场：EVERSHAG 坐在杂乱难寻的办公室里，用毫无表情的眼睛盯着 KRAY。
facts.anchor: EVERSHAG sat behind her cluttered desk in her cluttered, hard-to-find office, staring at KRAY with inexpressive eyes.

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 告诉 KRAY，人力资源部不负责招聘，招聘归 Hiring Division 管。
EVERSHAG 说这是政府机构，所以没人会被解雇。
KRAY 回忆七个月前在塞浦路斯执行线人解聘：DQFLOPSWEAT/7 是希腊族塞浦路斯人，入册两年只领小额月薪，没提供过俄罗斯黑钱情报。
facts.anchor: DQFLOPSWEAT/7, a Greek Cypriot recruited to report on movements of Russian mob money in and out of the island, hadn’t panned out after two years on the books collecting a small monthly stipend.

facts.fact: KRAY 自掏两百美元，把最终付款加到四百美元。
facts.anchor: “Look, I’ll make it four hundred,” said KRAY. “Including two hundred of my own money.

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 说中情局十一年内换过七套不同的考核系统。
facts.anchor: the Agency has had seven different evaluation systems in the last eleven years

facts.fact: EVERSHAG 当面说 KRAY 给人傲慢、居高临下的印象。
facts.anchor: “You come across as arrogant and condescending.”

facts.fact: KRAY 离开时顺走了 EVERSHAG 桌上的银色拆信刀。
facts.anchor: KRAY walked out, admiring the silver letter opener he had purloined from EVERSHAG’s messy desk.
